entries.en: What is going on here? Where are the guards? Where is Saren?
Saren will receive his proper reward when we find him.
What is this? One of my own fighting against the glorious rebirth of our kind?
Are you blind? We have a cure for the genophage! Saren has led us through the darkness to a new dawn!
Saren's not here. You get to deal with us.
No! Stay back! This is important work! This is the glorious salvation of my species!
You will not destroy the work we have started!
Saren is not here. You get to deal with us.
You're breeding an army of slaves! Tools to be manipulated. What glory is there in that?
Take him down.
Open your eyes!
He sees the truth.
He's not a puppet of Saren.
You're a puppet of Saren.
Private Menos Avot of the Third Infiltration Regiment STG, sir! Captured while on reconnaissance six days ago. Glad to answer, sir!
Never any questions from these bastards. Just whispers and poking and cutting. I'd have said anything to get out and get some payback.
What do you want? I told you everything! I--
Who are you? Alliance, right? I knew someone would come. It tried to break me, but it couldn't! I shut it out!
Slow down, I need to know where you came from.
Nobody is going anywhere until I get some answers.
Identify yourself. Now!
That's not too much to ask, is it? A little payback?
Experiments, but I don't know what for. The effect of incessant whispering on my shortening temper? Who knows? I just need out.
I'll be at your back every step of the way. I just need to get out of here and away from that incessant whispering. They've piped it in for days now.
Something's not right here, Shepard.
Something's not right here, Commander.
Something is not right here, Shepard.
Yes, leaving me here would be bad. Very bad. It's too small and the noise just won't go away. Whispering is loud, you know?
No! No, I need to get out. This room is too small and it keeps talking and I really want to get out of here and get some work done.
I need to get out. Let me out.
Can't take the chance... no chance. I need to do what it says. I have to. Let me out.
Let me out! Let me out! Let me out! Let me out!
Yes, sir! You'll find that I am very good at following orders!
I should be. I hear them over and over. Why are they repeated when they are so simple?
So damn simple!
What did they do to you, soldier?
Can you help me, or will I be carrying you out of here?
He's not part of the mission.
If we don't let him out, he's as good as dead. We have to do something.
Setting him free could endanger the mission.
I can't take that chance.
Set him free. He could help us.
What happened to you?
Are you fit to fight?
I can't just leave him.
Sorry. I can't risk it.
All right. Let him out.
Private Menos Avot of the Third Infiltration Regiment STG, ma'am! Captured while on reconnaissance six days ago. Glad to answer, ma'am!
Ar-rah-rah-ar.
Commander, look over here. It's another beacon. Like the one on Eden Prime.
Commander! Are you okay?
You are not Saren.
What is that? Some kind of VI interface?
Rudimentary creatures of blood and flesh. You touch my mind, fumbling in ignorance, incapable of understanding.
I don't think this is a VI...
There is a realm of existence so far beyond your own you cannot even imagine it. I am beyond your comprehension. I am Sovereign!
Reaper? A label created by the Protheans to give voice to their destruction. In the end, what they choose to call us is irrelevant. We simply are.
We are eternal. The pinnacle of evolution and existence. Before us, you are nothing. Your extinction is inevitable. We are the end of everything.
Commander? We got trouble!
That ship, Sovereign? It's moving. I don't know what you did down there, but that thing just pulled a turn that would shear any of our ships in half.
It's coming your way, and it's coming hard! You need to wrap things up in there -- fast!
This console is shot. Orders, Commander?
Right, Commander. I'll meet you there. Joker out.
This thing is fried. Orders, Commander?
This console is no longer functioning. Ideas, Commander Shepard?
This console's been disabled. Orders, Commander?
There's nothing we can do here. Ideas, Shepard?
I do not think this is a VI...
Shepard! Are you okay?
Commander! You okay?
Shepard, look over here. It's another beacon. Like the one on Eden Prime.
Whatever your plan is, it's going to fail. I'll make sure of that.
Lay it on me, Joker. I love bad news.
We'll head for the the breeding facility. Time to blow this place to hell.
Let's head to the breeding facility. Joker can pick us up after we set the nuke.
Hit me, Joker.
Sovereign isn't just some Reaper ship Saren found. It's an actual Reaper!
Great. More problems.
Let's go set the nuke.
We've got what we need.
You're... alive?
I'll stop you!
Your words are as empty as your future. I am the vanguard of your destruction. This exchange is over.
There is an entire galaxy of races united and ready to face you.
I don't stand alone!
My kind transcends your very understanding. We are each a nation. Independent, free of all weakness. You cannot even grasp the nature of our existence.
I get the feeling something bad is about to happen.
The Protheans vanished 50,000 years ago. You could not have been there. It's impossible!
The Protheans vanished 50,000 years ago. You couldn't have been there. It's impossible!
Organic life is nothing but a genetic mutation, an accident. Your lives are measured in years and decades. You wither and die.
Confidence born of ignorance. The cycle cannot be broken.
Cycle? What cycle?
The pattern has repeated itself more times than you can fathom. Organic civilizations rise, evolve, advance. And at the apex of their glory, they are extinguished.
The Protheans were not the first. They did not create the Citadel. They did not forge the mass relays. They merely found them, the legacy of my kind.
Your civilization is based on the technology of the mass relays, our technology. By using it, your society develops along the paths we desire.
We impose order on the chaos of organic evolution. You exist because we allow it. And you will end because we demand it.
They are harvesting us! Letting us advance to the level they need, then wiping us out!
They're harvesting us! They're here to wipe us out!
They're harvesting us! Letting us advance to the level they need, then wiping us out!
We have no beginning. We have no end. We are infinite. Millions of years after your civilization has been eradicated and forgotten, we will endure.
We are legion. The time of our return is coming. Our numbers will darken the sky of every world. You cannot escape your doom.
Why would you construct the mass relays, then leave them for someone else to find?
Where did you come from? Who built you?
Where are the rest of the Reapers? Are you the last of your kind?
What do you want from us? Slaves? Resources?
You're not even alive. Not really. You're just a machine. And machines can be broken!
The ship?
You don't scare me!
You built them?
Who created you?
Are there more of you?
I will stop you!
Impossible!
Ungh!
Huh-huh.
Gasp.
Don't shoot! Please, I just want to get out of here before it's too late.
You helped him and you don't even know why?
You helped him and you do not even know why?
You helped him and you didn't even know why?
Not this level. We're studying Sovereign's effect on organic minds. At least, that's what I assumed. Saren kept us in the dark as much as possible.
Rana Thanoptis, neurospecialist. But this job isn't worth dying over. Or worse.
Do I look like a soldier? I'm a neurospecialist. And this job isn't worthy dying over. Or worse.
You think the indoctrination only affects prisoners? Sooner or later, Saren will want to dissect my brain, too!
I-- I can help you! This elevator behind me goes to Saren's private lab. I can get you in.
I didn't have the option of negotiating. This position is a little more... permanent than I'd expected.
But I can help you. This elevator behind me goes to Saren's private lab. I can get you in.
See? Full access. All of Saren's private files. Are we good? Can I go?
I just did what I was told! I didn't have a choice. I'm sorry!
No! No!
What? You can't... but I'll never... ahh!
You enjoyed that.
I enjoyed that.
You enjoyed that, Commander.
I like the way you think, Shepard.
I believe you enjoyed that, Shepard.
Let's hear it. Who are you and what do you want?
Everyone in this place is trying to kill me.
Give me one reason I should help you.
You conducted brutal experiments on helpless test subjects. You helped Saren. You don't get to live.
Sorry doesn't help your victims.
I'm going to blow this place to hell and gone. If you want to make it out alive, you'd better start running.
I thought this was a breeding facility.
What are you talking about?
You deserve to die.
It's that ship, Sovereign. It emits some kind of... signal. Undetectable, but it's there. I've seen the effects. Saren uses it to influence his followers, to control them.
It's called indoctrination. Direct exposure to the signal turns you into a mindless slave, like the salarian test subjects. But there's collateral damage, too.
The signal comes from the ship. It makes us obey Saren, but I don't think he controls it. Not exactly. I think... he's scared it might be affecting him.
What were you studying here?
Why is Saren researching this? Isn't he the one controlling it?
